description: Vessel registrations is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Registration and vehicle information for all recreational vessels currently registered in Queensland. This extract does not include commercial vessel registrations. Please note: Content of the extract is representative of the state of the register as at 30 June 2020. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are postcode, recreation, registration, state, suburb. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
